subject: general
question: The successful automotive trials of the Zorawar light tank on 13 September 2024 were an important milestone for India's defence sector. Which organisation is responsible for developing this light tank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The indigenous light tank Zorawar was developed jointly by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and Larsen & Toubro (L&T).
 
• The prototype of Zorawar is ready and will soon undergo extensive trials.
 
• The tank is currently powered by a Cummins engine, with a project underway to develop a new engine domestically.
 
• It is designed to operate in extreme weather and high-altitude conditions with minimal logistic support.
 
• The tank will be subjected to various trials over the next six months, including tests in summer, winter, and high-altitude environments.
 
• The development of Zorawar was expedited to meet the Indian Army's needs for a lightweight, agile tank that can be deployed at high altitudes.
 
• The tank is versatile, built in a modular fashion, and capable of future upgrades, enhancing its tactical and operational mobility.
